coverage: Eight representative examples: oil, gas, coal, metal mining/processing, refining, management/logistics and two ports. Not a complete industry inventory.
temporalCoverage: Company operations descriptions are explicitly dated 2024 or 2025. Port coordinate pages have no displayed publication year and were checked on 2026-10-01. No current 2026 operating-status or output claim is inferred. EIA 2025 publication supplies 2024 national oil/dry-gas, 2023 national coal and estimated 2025 Omsk refinery capacity in text only.
geographicCoverage: The four representative locations lie away from disputed territories. These source pages are not used to construct national totals, national statistical boundaries or claims over Crimea and other disputed territories.
coordinateMethod: Natural Earth v5.1.2 Point records unchanged for Norilsk and Moscow. Published Rosmorport degree/minute coordinates converted to decimal degrees for Murmansk and Vladivostok. City and port reference positions are approximate teaching positions, not industrial facility entrances or survey/navigation data. Surgut, Kemerovo and Omsk: Natural Earth 50m; Novy Urengoy: 10m, both v5.1.2. These city reference positions are not facilities.
reuse: Only metadata, URLs, retrieval dates, hashes, selected public-domain city coordinates and minimal paraphrased factual statements are stored. Corporate and port pages, diagrams, photographs and articles are not republished.

limitations: Selected fixed-size examples do not encode amounts or ranks. Missing symbols do not imply absent industry.
The resource symbol is a representative city in a mining region, not an exact mine or factory coordinate.
The broader Vladivostok port reference position must not be described as the VMTP berth.
Transport modes are described from sources; routes are not estimated or drawn.
Company reports are operator-reported descriptions with their stated reference years, not independently measured regional statistics.

New energy examples are city reference anchors for resource regions; national amounts remain national text. Major steel and other manufacturing geography is not completed. USGS original PDF download returned 403 and was not bypassed.
